recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, saturated portrait of a woman with gravity-defying, sculptural braided hair ending in tufts, lying in a lush green field under a clear blue sky, featuring a conch shell in the foreground and bold, stylized typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The sculptural hair braids interact with the negative space of the sky.
The subject's upward gaze connects to the typography at the top edge.
The pink conch shell acts as a color and texture anchor in the foreground grass.
The rolling green hills provide a simplified, almost artificial backdrop to the complex subject.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, lying prone.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the pink conch shell in the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the conch shell up to the face, following the gaze to the hair, and finally to the header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of flat blue sky at the top provides breathing room for the complex hair and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant grass green and sky blue (background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (lips and typography) against the blue and green.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale pink (conch shell) and multicolored patterns (clothing).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all channels, creating a hyper-real, pop-art feel.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded corners on all exterior strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' features a circular dot that sits close to the stem
The 'a' and 'p' have large, open counters
The 'c' is a near-perfect open circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum graphic impact.
graphicDevices: Thin outer stroke to separate red text from blue sky

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the circular, modular feel of the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A woman with dark skin and elaborate, gravity-defying braids ending in reddish tufts, lying in a vibrant green field of grass. She is looking upwards with a smile. A pink conch shell is in the foreground. The background consists of rolling green hills under a clear, flat blue sky. High saturation, 90s photography style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase text at the top. Use a wide, rounded geometric sans-serif font in deep red with a very thin light-colored outline. Center the text horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the hair sculptural and reaching toward the top?
Is the color palette highly saturated?
Is the text lowercase and horizontally extended?
Is the conch shell present in the foreground?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the sky blue
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject
Distinct graphic separation between text and sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is strictly lowercase.
Ensure the green of the grass is vivid and occupies the lower half.
Verify the hair tufts have a distinct texture compared to the braids.
Confirm the conch shell is pinkish and clearly visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject with [eccentric hairstyle] + [vibrant landscape] + [wide geometric lowercase typography] = [90s Pop Surrealism]
